text: The 20 per-var questions become record fields: kind, resolution (twin/stdlib twin/alias/rt-target resolved before the record), calling convention (sig, arity shape), storage name, type (decl + type name). Fixed inputs: runtime interface (decls, intrinsics, globals/states) as one unit; context (ns, *program-file*, *stub-libs*, *box-params*, target options). q-fn-value (type ids) -> lg_tid_<name> constants; q-rt-const/q-rt-state are output dedupe, not inputs; q-prog-decls is module assembly, outside the boundary.
author: claude
